---
title: "panzoom on marked images, lightbox for the rest"
description: "`lightbox: true`, with some images marked for panzoom."
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
    lightbox: true
filters:
  - path: ../../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  hint: false
---

## About

The document turns lightbox on, and only images marked with `.panzoom` or
`#| classes: panzoom` open panzoom. Every other image opens lightbox, as in
[`a-lightbox`](a-lightbox.html). The markup is the same as in
[`d-panzoom-selective`](d-panzoom-selective.html), which has no lightbox.

```yaml
format:
  html:
    lightbox: true
filters:
  - panzoom
```

Case 6's first chunk has both `classes: panzoom` and `#| lightbox:`
options. panzoom takes that image, so it doesn't join the lightbox gallery.
Case 8 (`#| lightbox: false`) opens neither, and case 9's link still works,
since images inside links are left alone.

## 1. Single image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Beach in Chilmark](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left"}
```

## 2. Gallery in a layout {#c2 expect-open="glightbox panzoom glightbox"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Aquinnah](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah."}

![Oak Bluffs](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages."}

![Vineyard lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse."}
:::
```

## 3. Math {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$"}
```

## 4. Markdown subfigures {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Sub A](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a .panzoom}

![Sub B](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b .panzoom}

Two markdown subfigures (see @fig-md-a).
:::
```

## 5. R subfigures {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| classes: panzoom

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. Cell options {#c6 expect-open="panzoom glightbox"}

This one also has `classes: panzoom` (conflict test).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| classes: panzoom
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

This one has only the lightbox options.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Two plots in one cell {#c7 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| classes: panzoom
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. Opt-out {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```

## 9. Image in a link {#c9 expect-open="navigation"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
[![Linked image](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=30%}](https://quarto.org)
```

## 10. Margin image {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Margin image](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom .column-margin}
```

## 11. Inline image {#c11 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
Some text with an inline image ![](../../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom width=60px} in the middle.
```

## 12. Plain R figure {#c12 expect-open="glightbox"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-cap: A plain cross-referenced R figure.

image(volcano)
```
